title: RUNNING MAN - Learn In 2 Minutes | Dance Moves In Minutes

extraction.teacher_style: Jayden breaks down movements step by step with enthusiastic encouragement and clear directional cues. He demonstrates slowly from the side and front before adding speed and rhythm.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the running man dance move
Breaking down footwork facing the side
Practicing the steps facing the front
Adding detail about lifting the back foot on count two
Practicing slowly and repeating counts 1 and 2
Adding style by sliding the front leg back
Practicing the running man to music at full speed
Closing remarks and encouragement to practice

steps_taught.name: The Running Man
steps_taught.description: Jump split legs out and together while lifting the back knee up on count two.

what_works: Side angle view for clear visibility of footwork
Gradual addition of style and speed

quotes.text: Doesn't matter which foot you have out, let's say it's the right foot.
Now that's at its simplest form.
If you want to give it some style, you can start to slide the front leg back.
